description: 48x 100M/1GBASE-T access, 4x 1/10/25G SFP28 and 2x 40/100G QSFP28 uplink 1RU data-centre switch running NX-OS. The port side carries all fifty-four ports and the BCN, STS and ENV lamps. The other side carries the console, an RJ-45 and an SFP management port, the USB port, three fan modules and two power supplies. Ports number 1-54 and run DOWN each column, odd on the top row. Ships port-side intake (burgundy modules) or port-side exhaust (blue).

gaps.note: The front figure draws a column of seven rings at the right end beside the QSFP28 pair and a block of nine rings under the BCN, STS and ENV lamps. Callout 1 is "LEDs" and the text names no others, and appendix C lists the BCN, STS and ENV lamps and the port lamps only. They are drawn as marks without a state.
gaps.wanted: What the sixteen rings are, and whether they are lamps.

gaps.note: The guide's installation options name the NXK-ACC-KIT-1RU only. Its appendix D lists the kit's contents.
gaps.wanted: Nothing further: the one kit is modelled as cisco/nxk-acc-kit-1ru@1.

A drawing of the lid, the underside and the two side walls. The guide's overview shows the chassis only in the two flat views and calls out the grounding pad; no side wall is drawn and none can be measured.
A picture of the 350 W PHV, the 440 W DC and the 715 W DC supply. The guide's figure shows AC supplies only ("AC power supplies shown"). Their faces are the 350 W AC supply's with the inlet changed.
A stated size for the supplies and the fan module. The guide gives "Form factor RSP1" for the 350 W AC and PHV supplies and nothing for the fan.
A cage skin with a bail. The library's SFP cage has one skin and none shows a bail.

gaps.note: The Overview says the switch "will power down due to a fan-policy trigger if fewer than 2 fans are operational".
gaps.wanted: Whether the sentence counts fan modules or rotors. It is read as modules, two of three, so the group says 2+1.

attrs.redundancy-note: Installation guide, Overview: three fan modules of two rotors each. The switch "will power down due to a fan-policy trigger if fewer than 2 fans are operational". It works with one rotor failed in any one module and, with more than one rotor failed, warns and powers down in two minutes.

mgmt.mixed: the out-of-band block at the left end: an RJ-45 console port, an RJ-45 and an SFP management port and a USB port. Three media, one purpose: reaching the switch when the data plane cannot.

attrs.redundancy-note: installation guide: "Power supply modules (two-one for operations and one for redundancy [1+1])". Slot 1 is on the left and slot 2 on the right.

name: n9k-c9348gc-fx3

chassis-lamps.note: Callout 1 is "LEDs". The figure draws a boxed panel at the left end with three ring lamps in a column, legends BCN, STS and ENV to their left, at 9.1 mm across and 11.9, 15.8 and 19.7 mm down. Under them the figure draws a block of nine small rings in three rows and a mark; the guide does not name them and they are drawn as marks. The figure also draws a column of seven rings at the right end, beside the QSFP28 pair; they are drawn as marks and are in the gaps. The mark is the maker's logo; none is drawn, as the library's practice for a Cisco face is no logo artwork. The model legend under the uplinks, CISCO NEXUS N9K-C9348GC-FX3, is printed on the figure and is carried as text.

colour.note: NO SOURCE FOR THE COLOUR. The guide's figures are uncoloured line art. #d0d2cf is the value the 93180YC-EX's stencil sample gave, carried across as a family colour.

gate-1.note: The front figure's body, between its two end lines, is 1771 px across and 177 px down: aspect 10.0 against the guide's 17.3 x 1.72 in, 10.05, so 0.5% out, and it can be measured; 4.03 px per mm across from 439.4 mm and 4.05 down from 43.7. The rear figure's body is 1773 px across and 177 down, 10.0, 4.035 px per mm. A repeated feature checks the scale: the jack columns step 56 px, 13.9 mm, against the registry's 13.97 (0.5% out), so every pitch is the registry's and the figure fixes where each group starts.

port-lamps.note: Appendix C, Switch Chassis LEDs: "The port LEDs appear as triangles pointing up or down to the nearest port." Green is admin up, module present and link up; amber is admin down or module absent; off is up and present but no link. The figure draws the SFP28 triangles large, between the two cage rows, and the QSFP28 triangles at the ends of a band with eight small windows between them; the windows are drawn as marks and carry no state. The copper triangles are the printed arrows beside the numerals; the copper lamps are the rectangles under the jacks.

port-order.note: The figure prints a pair of numerals over each column of lamps with an up and a down triangle between them, "1 up down 2" to "47 up down 48", and "49 up down 50", "51 up down 52" and "53 up down 54" under the SFP28 and QSFP28 cages, so the odd port is the upper jack or cage. The guide's text gives 48 downlink ports, 4 SFP28 uplinks and 2 QSFP28 uplinks and does not number them. Port numbers are as printed; the NX-OS interface names are not in the guide.

power.note: Appendix B, Switch Power Input Requirements: typical 226 W and maximum 242 W "(AC or DC)", 825.738 BTU per hour. The figures are the switch's draw and not a supply rating; the guide names no configuration or ambient.

rack-ears.note: The guide's NXK-ACC-KIT-1RU procedure says the holes used depend on the rack and on the clearance needed for interface cables, 3 inches minimum, and for module handles, 1 inch minimum, and its figure shows two ways to mount the brackets. None dimensions a position and none says which the box ships with, so the two positions are written without an `at`, named for what the text says they clear, and none is the default.

rear-face.note: Every x and y on the module side is read off the rear figure (4.035 px per mm across, 4.05 down). The console jack over the RJ-45 management jack, the USB port stood on end, the SFP management port, two lamps labelled BCN and STS, a grounding pad with two screws, three fan modules, then supply 1 and supply 2. THE OUT-OF-BAND BLOCK IS AT THE LEFT END, as on the 93180YC-EX. The figure draws small airflow legends, F1 and F2 with arrows, beside the first fan and P1 and P2 beside the supplies; they are not carried. The management SFP cage is the registry's plain one.

sources.note: One guide, held as PDF and as converted text and figures; it is not committed. Cisco N9348GC-FX3 NX-OS Mode Switch Hardware Installation Guide, First Published 2023-08-18, Last Modified 2026-09-18, 64 pages: the overview and its figures (art numbers 505030 and 504861), appendix B specifications, appendix C LEDs, appendix D kits. THE GUIDE'S FIGURES ARE CLEAN FLAT LINE ART AT ABOUT 4 PX PER MM and carry callouts; they are read from the PDF's embedded bitmaps. NO DATA SHEET, PHOTOGRAPH, 3D MODEL OR STENCIL IS HELD for this model, and the NetBox devicetype-library is held as a path listing only: it names a device type with a front and a rear elevation for this model, and no file was read.

stack-orientation.note: The library's convention: the upper cage upright over the lower turned 180, and the upper jack turned 180 over the lower one. The front figure draws the upper jacks with their latch notch up and the lower jacks with the notch down, which is that arrangement.

the-width.note: The guide's Switch Dimensions table: "17.3 inches (43.9 cm)" wide, "1.72 inches (4.4 cm) (1 RU)" high, and for depth "Chassis without PSUs - 18.0 in (45.72 cm)" and 19.7 in (49.9 cm) with the NXA-PAC-350W or NXA-PHV-350W supplies and 21.0 in (53.34 cm) with the NXA-PDC-440W or NXA-PDC-715W-PI supplies. The chassis depth carried is the first, 457.2 mm: the library's depth is the chassis, and the others include the modules. 439.4 mm and 43.7 mm are carried, the inch figures converted. The weights table gives the chassis "14.5 lb (6.57 kg)".

the-x-axis.note: From the front figure, origin the left end line. FOUR boxed groups of six jack columns: the boxes start at 13.6, 103.9, 194.2 and 284.5 mm, a stride of 90.3, and the jacks stand 2.8 mm inside each box, so the columns start at 16.15, 106.45, 196.75 and 287.05 mm (the figure's jack outline is 12.2 wide against the registry's 12.7, centred). At the registry's 13.97 mm pitch the stride is a gutter of 6.5 mm. The two SFP28 columns start at 375.9 and 391.0 mm and the QSFP28 pair at 409.9 mm.

the-y-axis.note: From the same figure, origin the top line. The upper jack's centre is at 15.4 mm and the lower jack's at 30.0, a 14.6 mm row pitch; with the registry's 11.0 high cell the upper jack runs 9.9 to 20.9 mm. The SFP28 cages run 9.7 to 20.1 and 25.4 to 35.8, and the QSFP28 cages 9.8 to 19.95 and 25.2 to 35.35. THE PORT LAMPS ARE SMALL RECTANGLES BELOW THE JACKS, one under each port, 4.4 by 2.7 mm in the figure, so common/led-rect@1 (4.6 x 2.6), two to a column, the left one for the upper port, at 38.8 mm; the numerals and a pair of arrows stand above them at about 37 mm.
